activity.title: I Fed My Employment Contract to an AI. It Found 3 Clauses HR Doesn't Want You to Notice.

drafts.text:
Your employment contract has landmines HR hopes you never find.

I fed mine to an AI. In 12 minutes it surfaced:
• A non-compete covering "anticipated" competitors
• An IP clause that could've claimed my side project
• A PTO forfeiture buried in Appendix B

The tool keeps your PDF private (nothing uploaded).
